text:
ria: Quick sync request  we need to settle on a stable join key and PII rules for SLO suppression (what we call quiet windows) before rollout. dashboards are mis-joining a few events.

mike: what's mis-joining?

ria: Example: staging emits ephemeral quiet_id for API-created previews. dashboards group by quiet_id so alerts from the same logical window get split. We need a stable join key (hash) + fallbacks.

olivia: we already have quiet_id + applied_by in the DB. Can we derive a stable hash from tenant+scope+start? risk: identical windows across tenants.

kevin: propose quiet_hash = sha256(tenant_id + scope + start_ts + canonical_reason_short) then truncate. That gives stable grouping and avoids exposing emails.

mike: ok but console wants a human-readable contact for handoff. we can't just show a hash.

ria: UX wants owner_display (short) visible; security prefers no email in the streaming preview. compromise: owner_display optional, owner_contact hashed. 

olivia: telemetry / metrics pipeline needs either quiet_id (preferred) or quiet_hash fallback. I can change the consumer to prefer id then hash.

kevin: also add tags for correlation: slo_id, rule_rev, route_tag. example: tags:["slo:err_99","rule:rev42","route:eu-west-1"]. keeps joins easier.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: notify-preview v1.2.4 deployed to staging. Watch for schema errors.

mike: compatibility question: will adding owner_display break mobile clients?

ria: we'll keep owner_display optional and behind feature flag for mobile. console will show if present.

olivia: can we include a consent flag on the quiet record? so owner_display only surfaces when consent_given=true. That helps enterprise customers.

kevin: adding consent field is cheap. proto snippet I suggest:

```
message QuietInfo {
  string id = 1;
  string scope = 2; // tenant|route|global
  string hash = 3; // stable join key
  optional string owner_display = 4;
  optional bool owner_consented = 5;
  repeated string tags = 6; // slo_id, route, etc.
}
```

mike: docs-bot can you record the schema change and generate a migration checklist?

docs-bot: docs-bot: Created ticket DOCS-842: "Notify-preview: QuietInfo schema + migration notes".

ria: acceptance criteria: 1) telemetry accepts quiet_hash fallback, 2) console shows owner_display only if owner_consented or enterprise opt-in, 3) SDKs updated with examples, 4) migration note for Dedicated customers.

olivia: i'll implement the consumer shim: `use id if present else use hashFallback(hash)` and add unit tests.

kevin: security review: if we only send display name (no email) and flag consent, should be ok. i'll ping sec for sign-off.

mike: timeline?

ria: kevin will land proto + api change this week, olivia updates consumer, docs follow, staging QA next Wed.

olivia: one more thing: sampling. we should emit a telemetry field `sample_rate` so downstream estimators can adjust.

kevin: included. final proto includes an optional `sample_rate` float. keep defaults at 1.0.

mike: sounds good. please add example event in DOCS ticket with `quiet_applied` payload fields: id, hash, scope, owner_display (opt), owner_consented, tags, sample_rate, applied_by.

ria: all set. i'll create the implementation tickets and assign owners. thanks everyone.
